topic: Calibration changes and session migration status
summary_markdown: The conversation concerns the progress of migrating sessions to a new calibration structure. Initially, [me] reported that only 2022 data was successfully migrated overnight. [p1] suggested waiting until all sessions were ready for migration. [me] confirmed that if delaying until tomorrow is acceptable, they plan to proceed with the conversion using the new scheme.
decisions: Delay session migration until the next day (tomorrow).
